*   **Precision:** The method relies on accurate projection of 3D covariance to 2D to determine splat size and falloff [S2].

The claim states that the method relies on accurate projection of 3D covariance to 2D to determine splat size and falloff. The evidence explicitly confirms this: 1) It states that 'covariance values indicate the orientation and size of the 2D Gaussian into which a 3D Gaussian projects'. 2) It specifies that 'The size of a splat is set such that it covers the 99% confidence interval of the projected Gaussian.' 3) It notes that the pixel shader computes 'exponential color and opacity falloff based on distance to splat center' (which is derived from the projected 2D position). Thus, all facts in the claim are present in the evidence.
